components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped
            from the national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+', and that E.164 string is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag acknowledging, on create, that this owner
            deliberately shares a household with an existing owner (same last
            name and address). When true it waives the duplicate-household
            rejection that otherwise responds with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name, a hyphen, and a
                zero-padded 4-digit global sequence number assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household.
                Assigned on create when the request opts into a shared household
                (sharesHousehold true) and an existing same-last-name owner lives
                at the same address; both owners then carry this identifier.
                Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: '3f2504e0-4f89-3d63-9c60-8f5b6b0a1c2d'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared its first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>':
                the customer code, the literal '-M', and the last two digits of
                the registration date's year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier: 'SILVER' when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0) and an email address on file,
                otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the canonical region derived from the city
                using a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne ->
                VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the
                table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the `bulkSignupWarning` flag as a derived, read-time field on the owner response.

**Design:** The flag reuses the same per-day registration count the daily-limit rule already relies on (`ClinicService.countOwnersRegisteredOn`), just with a lower threshold — so it's the same accumulation path, per the test's own note.

Changes, each in its own single-responsibility unit:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a `readOnly` boolean `bulkSignupWarning` to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field.

2. **`service/BulkSignupWarningEvaluator.java`** (new) — a small component that answers one question: is the warning warranted for a given owner? It returns `true` when more than 80 owners (`BULK_SIGNUP_THRESHOLD`) share the owner's registration date, `false` otherwise (including when the owner/date isn't known). It sits beside the count logic in the service layer, delegating to `ClinicService` rather than duplicating the count.

3. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — converted the interface to an abstract class (component model is already `spring`) so it can hold the injected evaluator, then added `bulkSignupWarning` as a mapped expression alongside the existing derived fields (`displayName`, `initials`, etc.). This keeps the warning consistent across every owner response (get, list, create) via the one place that builds `OwnerDto`, rather than scattering it across controller methods.

The `AcceptanceTest` (fresh create → `bulkSignupWarning: false`) passes, and the full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1 test, 0 failures).
